Code notes
• No separate EVSE disconnect: 32 A at 240 V (120 V to ground) is within the 60 A and 150 V limits of NEC 625.43.
• Hardwired EVSE: the GFCI rule in NEC 625.54 covers receptacle outlets only. Personnel protection is built into the listed EVSE (NEC
625.22).
• Outdoor outlet on a 40 A circuit: confirm with the inspector whether NEC 210.8(F) GFCI protection applies. DEMO
